<p>We are delighted to announce the <strong>43rd Meeting of the European Group of Process Tracing Studies (EGPROC 2025)</strong>. The conference will take place on Thursday and Friday, <strong>June 26th and 27th, 2025</strong>, at the <strong><u><a href="https://www.jads.nl/">Jheronimus Academy of Data Science</a></u><a href="https://www.jads.nl/"> </a>in ’s-Hertogenbosch, Netherlands.</strong> </p>
